title: TICOM and ALSOS technology retrieval

tellings.quote: Nazis had all this advanced technology and you had TACOM and ASOS.

plain: Jesse Michels says that the Nazis had a lot of advanced technology at the end of the Second World War, and that the Allies ran programmes to collect it, which he calls "TACOM and ASOS" and which are known as TICOM and ALSOS, efforts in Europe in 1944 and 1945 to retrieve German technology and know-how. He mentions this in passing, without naming a source, in an episode with a former presidential advisor, Harald Malmgren, as background to how advanced technology may have ended up in American hands.
